description: The City of Kragujevac, a Serbian city of about 170,000 people, publishes its utility network GIS layers on the national open data portal data.gov.rs. Contents: separate datasets for the water supply network (points such as valves, hydrants and connections, pipe lines and polygons, about 43 MB in total), the sewerage network (about 23 MB), the gas distribution network (about 14 MB), the district heating network (about 6 MB) and the electricity network (about 26 MB, with facility locations, manholes, service connections, connection cabinets, poles and line routes, and transformer stations); related datasets give the street network, traffic, bus lines and stops, a GTFS feed and public parking. Producer: the city administration, compiling the layers of its utilities. Coverage: the territory of the City of Kragujevac. Format and access: each dataset has GeoJSON and CSV files for points, lines and polygons, downloadable without registration; the files were first published in January 2022 and the entries were refreshed in September 2026. Licence: Open Data Licence of the Republic of Serbia (attribution). Caveats: attribute names and codes are in Serbian and undocumented beyond the dataset description; the geometry reflects the 2022 export, and some layers mix networks of several operators. Simulation uses: rare open example of all five urban utility networks for one mid-sized European city, suited to interdependency and cascading failure studies, water and heat network hydraulic models, and co-location analysis of buried utilities. Related records: none in the catalogue cover Serbian municipal utility networks.
